items.title: fo-dicom
items.description: Fellow Oak DICOM, a DICOM toolkit in C# for all .NET Standard 2.0 compatible frameworks.

items.title: dicom-server
items.description: The Medical Imaging Server for DICOM is an open source DICOM server that is easily deployed on Azure.

items.title: DICOMcloud
items.description: A standalone DICOMWeb server with RESTful implementation of the DICOMWeb/WADO services. The DICOMcloud server can interface with any DICOMWeb client over the current implemented features (qido-rs, wado-uri, wado-rs and stow-rs).

items.title: Evil-DICOM
items.description: A simple to use library for reading and manipulating DICOM files.

items.title: SimpleITK
items.description: A simplified interface for the Insight Toolkit ITK with several components supporting general filtering operations, image segmentation, and registration.

items.title: CTK
items.description: The Common Toolkit is a community effort to provide support code for medical image analysis, surgical navigation, and related projects.

items.title: DCMTK
items.description: The DICOM ToolKit (DCMTK) package consists of source code, documentation and installation instructions for a set of software libraries and applications implementing part of the DICOM/MEDICOM Standard.

items.title: MITK
items.description: The Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit (MITK) is a free open-source software system for development of interactive medical image processing software. MITK combines the Insight Toolkit (ITK) and the Visualization Toolkit (VTK) with an application framework.

items.title: GDCM
items.description: Grassroots DICOM (GDCM) is an implementation of the DICOM standard designed to be open source, so that researchers may access clinical data directly. GDCM includes a file format definition and a network communications protocol, both of which should be extended to provide a full set of tools for a researcher or small medical imaging vendor to interface with an existing medical database.

items.title: vtk-dicom
items.description: A set of classes for managing DICOM files and metadata from within VTK, and some utility programs for interrogating and converting DICOM files.

items.title: dcmqi
items.description: DICOM for Quantitative Imaging (dcmqi) is a collection of libraries and command line tools with minimum dependencies to support standardized communication of quantitative image analysis research data using the DICOM standard.

items.title: Orthanc
items.description: A simple yet powerful standalone DICOM server. It is designed to improve the DICOM flows in hospitals and to support research about the automated analysis of medical images.

items.title: dcm2niix
items.description: Convert neuroimaging data from the DICOM format to the NIfTI format.

items.title: DicomToMesh
items.description: A command line tool to transform a DICOM volume into a 3d surface mesh (obj, stl or ply). Several mesh processing routines can be enabled, such as mesh reduction, smoothing or cleaning.

items.title: wsi-to-dicom-converter
items.description: Convert whole slide images (WSIs) to DICOM.

items.title: DICOMautomaton
items.description: A multipurpose tool for analyzing medical physics data with a focus on automation.

items.title: dovo
items.description: Cross-platform software for importing DICOM CD/files and sending to PACS.

items.title: dcm4che
items.description: A collection of open source applications and utilities for the healthcare enterprise.

items.title: Dicoogle
items.description: An extensible, platform-independent and open-source PACS archive software that replaces the traditional centralized database with a more agile indexing and retrieval mechanism.

items.title: healthcare-dicom-dicomweb-adapter
items.description: A set of components that translate between traditional DICOM DIMSE protocols (e.g., C-STORE) and the RESTful DICOMWeb protocols (e.g., STOW-RS).

items.title: dcmjs
items.description: JavaScript implementation of DICOM manipulation. This code is an outgrowth of several efforts to implement web applications for medical imaging.

items.title: Daikon
items.description: A pure JavaScript DICOM reader.

items.title: dicomweb-client
items.description: JavaScript client implementation of DICOMWeb.

items.title: dicomweb-pacs
items.description: Easy to use DICOMWeb enabled PACS with DIMSE services based on sqlite database.

items.title: dicomweb-server
items.description: Lightweight DICOMWeb Server with CouchDB.

items.title: dcmjs-dimse
items.description: DICOM DIMSE implementation for Node.js using the dcmjs library.

items.title: Efferent.Dicom
items.description: Ligthweight JS/TS/Node library for reading and writing DICOM files

items.title: dcmjs-codecs
items.description: DICOM file and dataset transcoding for Node.js and browser using the dcmjs library.

items.title: Viewers
items.description: A zero-footprint medical image viewer provided by the Open Health Imaging Foundation (OHIF). It is a configurable and extensible progressive web application with out-of-the-box support for image archives which support DICOMWeb.

items.title: DWV
items.description: DICOM Web Viewer (DWV) is an open source zero footprint medical image viewer library. It uses only JavaScript and HTML5 technologies, meaning that it can be run on any platform that provides a modern browser (laptop, tablet, phone and even modern TVs).

items.title: NiiVue
items.description: A WebGL module that can be embedded into HTML, Vue.js, Angular, React, Electron and Capacitor frameworks. It provides scripting and drag and drop abilities to visualize and render voxel-based images (e.g., DICOM and NIfTI), meshes, and tractography streamlines and connectomes, as well as drawing functions (demos).

items.title: VolView
items.description: Web based radiological viewer for clinical professionals. Built with Vue.js and VTK.js.

items.title: dicomviewer
items.description: A DICOM viewer which uses the cornerstone.js library to display DICOM files in Nextcloud.

items.title: U Dicom Viewer
items.description: A simple but functional DICOM viewer for any device with a web browser. Allows opening and viewing 2D medical images in a wide variety of DICOM formats.

items.title: bluelight
items.description: Browser-based medical image viewer primarily maintained by the Imaging Informatics Labs. It is a pure single-page application (SPA), lightweight, and using only JavaScript and HTML5 technologies to easily deploy it on any HTTP server.

items.title: dwv-react
items.description: Medical viewer using DWV and React.

items.title: dicom-microscopy-viewer
items.description: Vanilla JS library for web-based visualization of DICOM VL Whole Slide Microscopy Image datasets and derived information.

items.title: dcmjs-imaging
items.description: DICOM image and overlay rendering pipeline for Node.js and browser using the dcmjs library.

items.title: dicom.ts
items.description: A small, superfast JS DICOM renderer.

items.title: dicomViewerLib
items.description: An Angular 9+ DICOMWeb viewer component, based on the cornerstone.js project.

items.title: dcmjs-ecg
items.description: DICOM electrocardiography (ECG) rendering for Node.js and browser using dcmjs.

items.title: pydicom
items.description: A pure Python package for working with DICOM files. It lets you read, modify and write DICOM data in an easy "pythonic" way.

items.title: MedPy
items.description: An image processing library and collection of scripts targeted towards medical (i.e. high dimensional) image processing.

items.title: pynetdicom
items.description: A pure Python 3.7+ package that implements the DICOM networking protocol. Working with pydicom, it allows the easy creation of DICOM Service Class Users (SCUs) and Service Class Providers (SCPs).

items.title: highdicom
items.description: Provides high-level DICOM abstractions for the Python programming language to facilitate the creation and handling of DICOM objects for image-derived information, including image annotations, and image analysis results.

items.title: dicomweb-client
items.description: Provides client interfaces for DICOMWeb RESTful services QIDO-RS, WADO-RS and STOW-RS to search, retrieve and store DICOM objects over the web, respectively.

items.title: dicom2nifti
items.description: Convert MR and CT-derived DICOM files to NIfTI.

items.title: heudiconv
items.description: A flexible DICOM converter for organizing brain imaging data into structured directory layouts.

items.title: dicom2stl
items.description: Convert a DICOM series to an STL surface mesh.

items.title: dcmstack
items.description: DICOM to NIfTI conversion with the added ability to extract and summarize metadata from the source files.

items.title: bidskit
items.description: CLI for converting a directory of DICOM files into a BIDS-compliant dataset.

items.title: Dicomifier
items.description: A set of tools to convert Bruker data to DICOM files, and DICOM files to NIfTI.

items.title: deid
items.description: Best effort anonymization for medical images in Python.

items.title: dicom-anonymizer
items.description: A tool for anonymizing DICOM files according to the DICOM standard.

items.title: DICAT
items.description: A simple graphical tool that facilitates DICOM de-identification directly on a local workstation.

items.title: dcm-anon
items.description: PS3.15 Basic Profile anonymizer that emits a hash-chained GDPR/HIPAA compliance manifest and an independent post-run residual-PHI scan.

items.title: MRIcroGL
items.description: A cross-platform tool that supports many voxel-based image formats including DICOM. This natively compiled application provides a drag and drop user interface as well as Python scripting integration.

items.title: dicom-ecg-plot
items.description: Plot ECG data from DICOM (demo).

items.title: OnkoDICOM
items.description: DICOM-RT viewer with enhanced capabilities that make it useful for research in the field of Radiation Oncology.

items.title: dicom-standard
items.description: Parses the web version of the DICOM Standard into human and machine-friendly JSON files.

items.title: dcmrtstruct2nii
items.description: DICOM RT-Struct to nii-mask. This is a naïve approach to rasterizing rt-struct to masks in the NIfTI format.

items.title: dicom-numpy
items.description: A set of utilities for extracting data contained in DICOM files into Numpy ndarrays.

items.title: Niffler
items.description: A lightweight framework to facilitate executing machine learning pipelines and processing workflows on DICOM images and metadata.

items.title: mercure
items.description: A flexible DICOM routing and processing solution with user-friendly web interface and extensive monitoring functions.
Contributions welcome! Read the contribution guidelines first.
